content.title: FOODS FOR THE {{OVERLOOKED}} PARTS OF YOU
facts: CARROTS are good for EYES — they're rich in **beta-carotene**, which the body converts to **vitamin A** to support night vision and eye health.
SALMON is good for SKIN — its **omega-3 fatty acids** help keep skin hydrated, elastic, and less prone to irritation.
STRAWBERRIES are good for GUMS — they contain **vitamin C**, which supports **collagen** production for stronger, healthier gum tissue.
CRANBERRIES are good for the BLADDER — compounds in cranberries may help reduce bacteria sticking to the urinary tract lining.
TURMERIC is good for JOINTS — its active compound **curcumin** has natural **anti-inflammatory** properties that may ease stiffness.
ALMONDS are good for NERVES — they provide **magnesium** and **vitamin E**, both important for healthy nerve function and protection.
